verdict.rationale: Wrike documents its own native apps for iPhone and Android, and mentions a mobile inbox prioritization feature. Nothing shows that tasks can be fully managed on mobile or that the apps match desktop functionality. missing for 10: evidence of mobile task-management features (create/edit/assign/views), documentation of mobile-desktop feature parity, independent or hands-on corroboration of mobile app depth.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can manage my tasks from a full-featured native mobile app without missing desktop functionality

citations.quote: Help your team collaborate no matter where they are with Wrike's apps for Windows, Mac, iPhone, and Android.
